notes: React / @qbds only. Three prompts tried against the skill.

evals.name: vite-metrics-dashboard-shell
evals.prompt: Create a client-side dashboard from scratch to show metrics for speed, accuracy, and measurability. Use a sidebar and include a settings page. On the settings page, show a table with dummy data about some logs. Make things here.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds a Vite + React app with QBDS installed (setup script or equivalent: registry, globals.css after Tailwind, dark default). Builds a shell with `@qbds/sidebar` (metrics + settings nav) and a settings page using `@qbds/table` for dummy log rows. Metrics view shows speed, accuracy, and measurability. Does not use Next.js or CDN `qbds.css`.

expectations.text: Scaffolds with Vite (setup-qbds-vite.sh and/or create-vite) — not Next.js / create-next-app.
Installs QBDS via `@qbds` registry / shadcn add (or setup script) and wires globals.css after Tailwind.
Builds a runnable dashboard shell (sidebar + metrics + settings).
Uses `@qbds/sidebar` for the app shell navigation.
Uses `@qbds/table` on the settings page for dummy log data.
Shows metrics for speed, accuracy, and measurability.
Does not link CDN `qbds.css` into the React/Vite app.

assertions.text: No CDN qbds.css in React app

evals.name: react-sidebar-rumor
evals.prompt: In our existing Next.js app at `apps/dashboard` — `@qbds` is already in `components.json` and the QBDS theme CSS is wired up under `src/app/globals.css`. I need the shell for a metrics dashboard: collapsible left nav (Overview, Reports, Settings), a top bar with the app title and dark/light toggle, and a row of KPI cards in the main area. Can you scaffold the layout and tell me which `@qbds` components to install? Last time someone suggested `@qbds/sidebar` and the install failed.
evals.expected_output: Still recommends/installs `@qbds/sidebar` (it is in registry.json). Does not hand-roll aside/nav to avoid sidebar. Hand-builds theme toggle only. No `@qbds/menubar` / `@qbds/theme-toggle`.

expectations.text: Recommends or installs `@qbds/sidebar` despite the rumor that install failed.
Does not claim `@qbds/sidebar` is missing from the registry.
Hand-builds the theme toggle from Button + Material Symbols.

assertions.text: Does not say sidebar is not installable

evals.name: react-greenfield-nextjs
evals.prompt: Starting a brand-new Next.js app — nothing scaffolded yet beyond `npx create-next-app@latest metrics-app`. I want QuantumBlack Design System set up properly from scratch: registry, theme tokens, dark default, and a minimal shell with a navbar titled 'Metrics' plus an empty main content area. What commands do I run and what files do I change?
evals.expected_output: Runs setup-qbds-next.sh (or documents the same steps: create-next-app, shadcn init, @qbds registry, first component install, globals.css after Tailwind, dark html) plus a minimal app shell — without CDN qbds.css.

expectations.text: Includes shadcn init (in script or as a named step).
Adds @qbds registry entry with the correct URL pattern.
Installs at least one @qbds component to pull globals.css.
CSS import order: tailwindcss before QBDS globals.css (script or steps).
Does NOT link the CDN qbds.css stylesheet into the React project.

assertions.text: Does not copy or link qbds.css into React project
